description: Ecwid is an e-commerce platform allowing merchants to build and manage online stores across multiple sites and channels.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization code flow for public apps; access tokens / secret tokens for private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Ecwid account to set up a development environment and obtain access tokens or create apps.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering products, categories, orders, customers, discounts, payment, and shipping integrations.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Ecwid.
rationale: Ecwid offers a fully documented public REST API with self-serve free developer credential access.

evidence.note: Details OAuth2 and token authentication for Ecwid apps.
Documentation index for getting started and setting up development environments.
Shows REST API reference and broad integration options.
